items.title: Formal systems depend only on the support: for X Noetherian and I, J quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals with the same vanishing closed subset, the categories Coh(X, I) and Coh(X, J) are equivalent.
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter coherent.tex (Cohomology of Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: The affine case is complete in the span: equal vanishing sets give mutual containments I^c subset J, J^d subset I (Noetherian power lemma); the I-adic and J-adic completions of A then agree (algebra-lemma-change-ideal-completion); applying lemma-inverse-systems-affine (card L16388) twice transfers the equivalence. The general case glues explicitly: quasi-compactness produces global exponents c, d with I^c subset J and J^d subset I, and the functor is written down - (F_n) maps to the system (F_{cn}/J^n F_{cn}), which lands in Coh(X, J) with the verification checked on an affine covering (the author's single omitted-details clause), symmetrically in the other direction, with the mutual-inverse check named-omitted.
